identity.title: [v0.92.2][planning] Audit and refresh first-pass milestone documentation

values.summary: Establish the canonical denominator, audit relevant TBD and issue truth, reconcile all planning surfaces, validate the package, and prepare a findings-first review handoff.

steps.action: Build the canonical document, feature, work-package, sprint, and release-tail denominator.
Audit relevant active TBD sources and existing issue truth into explicit scheduling dispositions.
Reconcile the complete planning package so every issue is bounded and all machine and human surfaces agree.
Run focused structural, YAML, link, placeholder, scheduling-coverage, and diff-hygiene validation.
Prepare the review handoff, resolve actionable findings, and leave the package planned and number-free.

invariants: Complete and explicit TBD disposition denominator
One concrete result per planned issue
risks: Treating a stale TBD inventory as complete
Converting broad feature bundles into nominal single issues
Opening the milestone through documentation overclaim
stop_conditions: The canonical package denominator cannot be established
A relevant TBD source lacks a truthful disposition
Machine-readable and human-readable work-package identities disagree
A proposed scope move requires operator judgment
An actionable review finding remains unresolved
